description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientProviderRuntime class, which implements the IProviderRuntime interface for client-side provider runtime functionalities within the Orleans framework. It manages grain factory access, dependency injection, and extension binding for clients.

classes.name: ClientProviderRuntime
classes.description: Implements IProviderRuntime for client side, providing grain factory access, dependency resolution, and extension binding.

methods.name: ClientProviderRuntime
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain factory, service provider, and client context.

methods.description: Property providing access to the grain factory.

methods.name: ServiceProvider
methods.description: Property providing access to the service provider.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Method to bind and retrieve extensions for the client context.
